items.name: Hameln fill-finish expansion: two new pre-filled syringe/cartridge lines
items.claim: Siegfried is expanding fill-finish capabilities at its Hameln site by adding two new manufacturing lines for pre-filled syringes and cartridges, the first expected to generate revenue in 2026 and the second in 2027.
items.source_excerpt: At its Hameln site, in addition to expanding its fill-finish capabilities, Siegfried is adding two new manufacturing lines for pre-filled syringes and cartridges, the first expected to start generating revenue in 2026 and the second in 2027.

items.name: Acquisition of US/Australia drug substance manufacturing capacity
items.claim: In January 2026, Siegfried announced the acquisition of high-quality small-molecule drug substance manufacturing capacity in the United States and Australia.
items.source_excerpt: In January 2026, Siegfried announced the acquisition of high-quality small molecules drug substance manufacturing capacity in the United States and Australia, representing a major strategic milestone for the Group.

notes: Both items are Siegfried's own ad hoc/media releases (H1 2025 results, Aug 21 2025; FY2025 results, Feb 20 2026) naming dated Hameln fill-finish capacity and a US/Australia drug-substance acquisition.
